description: Rural ZCTAs with very large land areas exceed the serviceability cap and cannot be auto-selected.
expected_behavior: A starting ZIP over 400 sq mi is included but flagged UNSERVICEABLE_LAND_AREA.
Oversized neighbours are never auto-selected, so rural proposals stall below minimum viable size.
From compact 82609 the generator adds 82636 but not oversized 82604, and still ends below minimum viable; a human exception is required for rural markets.
